THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
ORDER UNDER SECTION 38 (a)
Order No. 94 of 2019
My Ref. No.: 13/98/E/165.Divisional Secretary’s Ref. No.: Hangu/3/2/3/99.

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Proviso (a) to Section 38 ofthe Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) I, Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms do hereby direct theAcquiring Officer or any other officer authorized by him referred toin Paragraph 1 of the Schedule to take immediate possession of theland specified in the corresponding entry in Paragraph 2 of thatSchedule.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.09th April, 2019.

1. Lot No. 01 – Hanguranketha Watta – Extent: About1.782 HectaresNorth: T.P. 41960 and Lot No. 3 of P.P. Nu 815; East: Lot No. 3of P.P. Nu 815, T.P. 41960 and Lot No. 3 of P.P. Nu 815; South: LotNo. 3 of P.P. Nu 815, T.P. 41960, Lot No. 3 of P.P. Nu 815, LotNo. 5 of P.P. A 730 and Lot Nos. 3 and 2 of this plan; West: LotNos. 3,2 and Highway.
